title: Layer of Truth: Probing Belief Shifts under Continual Pre-Training Poisoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on factual integrity and belief shifts in LLMs due to data poisoning. While it evaluates models using alignment benchmarks like HH-RLHF (Helpful, Honest, Harmless) to check for downstream behavioral changes, this is used as a safety check rather than a primary evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
